svg.title: Triangle, shared and separate variance Gaussian, and Gamma decisions on one histogram
svg.desc: All four panels repeat the same 60-bin histogram of 2500 illustrative intensities made from deterministic Gamma quantiles. Triangle chooses the bin with maximum peak-to-longer-tail distance. Gaussian panels fit two weighted normal densities with either one shared variance or separate component variances. Gamma fits two weighted positive-support Gamma densities. The mixture panels show the raw higher-mean responsibility and the saved increasing component score at cutoff 0.5. The Triangle panel shows its binary intensity decision, with no probability model. Histogram and density axes are identical. Gates, curves, and counts are produced by the current implementation; the input population is synthetic.
